subject.title: Memory system: Cannot delete stale memories, conflicting entries persist

question: Should memory-lancedb expose a model-visible exact deletion selector from memory_recall now, or should this wait for the broader memory lifecycle contract?
rationale: Source and live evidence show the current deletion handoff gap, but the safe permanent contract depends on whether maintainers want raw UUIDs in recall content, numeric selector state, or a broader tombstone/supersede workflow.

options.title: Expose recall UUIDs now
options.body: Add UUIDs to model-visible memory_recall output with focused recall-to-forget regression coverage, and leave conflict lifecycle semantics to the broader tracker.

options.title: Defer to lifecycle design
options.body: Keep this issue open as product input for the broader memory review/edit/forget/conflict contract before adding another deletion selector.

options.title: Keep query-only deletion
options.body: Document the extra memory_forget(query) round trip as the supported path, accepting that recall results remain non-deletable by themselves.

recommendation.title: Expose recall UUIDs now
recommendation.body: Add UUIDs to model-visible memory_recall output with focused recall-to-forget regression coverage, and leave conflict lifecycle semantics to the broader tracker.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent release/current-main history makes this the best available routing candidate for memory-lancedb contract direction.
